approved_payload.content: Police say an 18-year-old man died after community members, who accused him of trying to rob a foreign-owned shop in Rostock village, attacked him with sticks, stones and cables at about 18:00 on Sunday 11 October. His family took him from the scene while he was still breathing; he died on arrival at a local hospital (police spokesperson Col Malesela Ledwaba, via TimesLIVE and SABC News). Mecklenburg police opened a murder case and are looking for the suspects, who have not been identified. No arrest has been reported. The victim is not named here. Two reports, both resting on the same police statement: TimesLIVE and SABC News. MAP POINT ESTIMATED: Rostock village could not be placed on a map, so the pin sits on the Mecklenburg police station, the police area that handled the case. It is not the scene; the village may be up to about 27 km away.
